Feedback

A control for rating an agent's answer as helpful or not helpful, with an optional follow-up note and a confirmation.

Status: draft

Examples

When to use it

  • Under an agent's answer or at the end of a turn, to record whether it helped.
  • When a rating can be followed by an optional note on what was wrong.

When not to use it

  • To answer a request an agent is waiting on. Use an approval, which carries Allow and Decline.
  • To accept or reject a run's work. Use buttons that name the action, such as Accept changes.
  • For a rating on a scale, or a choice among several options. Use radio inputs in a field.
  • For a setting that turns something on or off. Use a checkbox or a switch.

Accessibility

  • Use a div with role="group" and aria-labelledby pointing at gw-feedback__prompt, which asks the question in words, such as Was this answer helpful?
  • Each choice is a button element with type="button" and the classes gw-button gw-button--small gw-feedback__choice, and the two sit together in gw-feedback__choices. It holds an icon with aria-hidden="true" and the words Helpful or Not helpful. Never use the icon alone.
  • Both buttons carry aria-pressed. The app sets aria-pressed="true" on the chosen one and "false" on the other. Pressing the chosen button again clears the rating. The pressed button is drawn with a darker outline, a shade and a heavier label, not a colour alone.
  • Keep an empty p with the class gw-feedback__confirmation and role="status" in the group from the start. After a choice is saved, the app writes one line into it, such as Rated helpful. Thank you., and a screen reader announces it. It takes no room while empty.
  • The follow-up note is an app-set pattern, not a state of the component. After a choice, the app inserts gw-feedback__note between the row and the confirmation, or removes its hidden attribute: a gw-field whose control is a gw-textarea, with a visible label, and a secondary button, Send note. The rating is saved by the first press, and the note is optional. Do not move focus into the field: the reader reaches it with Tab.
  • After the note is sent, set the disabled attribute on both choices, leave aria-pressed as it is, remove the note field and say so in the confirmation.
  • If saving fails, set both buttons back to aria-pressed="false" and add a p with the class gw-feedback__error and role="alert" that says the rating was not saved and what to do. Its icon is drawn by the stylesheet.
  • Tab reaches Helpful, then Not helpful, then the note field and Send note when shown. Enter and Space press a button. The buttons are drawn 32px tall with a 44px pointer target.
